question: Should OpenClaw accept this restart-specific durable audit table with redacted source/session/preflight metadata and 512-row fixed retention, or should the work be narrowed or deferred to the broader audit-ledger direction?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a mechanical code defect: it is whether the durable local metadata boundary and restart-path persistence are the desired product/security contract.

options.title: Accept After Rebase
options.body: Resolve the current-main conflicts, preserve newer restart semantics, and merge once maintainers accept the durable audit schema, redaction, and retention policy.

options.title: Narrow Persistent Metadata
options.body: Require a smaller persisted column/payload set or stricter redaction policy before merging the restart audit producer.

options.title: Defer To Audit Ledger
options.body: Pause or close this PR if restart audit records should wait for a broader canonical audit-ledger design.

recommendation.title: Accept After Rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the current-main conflicts, preserve newer restart semantics, and merge once maintainers accept the durable audit schema, redaction, and retention policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans shared SQLite state, restart behavior, and the metadata privacy boundary, all areas where recent history points to steipete as the strongest routing candidate.
